title: Campus library announcement (contoh sintetis)
passage: Attention students. The university library will close at six p.m. this Friday for scheduled maintenance. If you need to borrow a book, please visit the circulation desk before five thirty. The library will reopen at nine a.m. on Saturday. Study rooms in the student center will remain available during the closure.
prompt: Why will the university library close early on Friday?
options: A public holiday is being observed.
The staff will attend a training session.
All study rooms have been reserved.
explanation: The announcement states that the library will close early for scheduled maintenance.
